# TaskChampion history-segment codec fixtures

These fixtures are the owned corpus for `merged_sync_gateway::codec`.

- `generated/*.json` are raw `history_segment` payloads captured from public
  TaskChampion APIs (`Replica<InMemoryStorage>`, public `Task` mutation methods,
  and `replica.sync()` with a capture `taskchampion::Server`). They are not
  copied from TaskChampion private source.
- `invalid/*.json` are hand-written fail-closed fixtures for unknown/new
  variants and unknown fields.
- `CODEC_REVIEW.toml` pins the TaskChampion version reviewed with this corpus.
  `just codec-gate` fails when the resolved `taskchampion` version in
  `Cargo.lock` no longer matches the acknowledgement.

Regenerate generated fixtures only as part of an explicit codec review:

```bash
cargo test merged_sync_gateway::codec::tests::regenerate_taskchampion_history_fixtures \
  --lib -- --ignored --exact
cargo test merged_sync_gateway::codec --lib
just codec-gate
```

The generated bytes include operation timestamps, so fixture diffs are expected
when regenerating. Review decoded operation shapes, not just byte diffs.
